Southern Railway achieved 100% Broad Gauge electrification (5,068 route km) after which 71-km section?

questions.explanation: 14 September; Hindi is the Union’s official language under Article 343.

questions.explanation: Over 80 lakh doses in six months; UP recorded the highest (22 lakh+).

questions.explanation: Context: National Conclave on Tribal Languages and Museums, Mysuru (Adi Vaani upgraded).
